html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 29, 2022

On Jun 28, 2022, HNWI-sector smart marketing SaaS Yuanquan Tech (原圈科技) (founded 2017) closed a ¥50M Series A+ led by Changchun Teng Capital, with returning SIG China and Jingya — 4th round — for product R&D and market expansion. Long-funnel stack (acquire → manage → follow → nurture) for property core + auto / home decoration / furniture; content → traffic → private domain → on-site CRM. ’21 contracts and ASP both doubled; AI/automation screens public+private leads from Baidu/WeChat/Toutiao.

— END —
